column2: Ghrond

By decree of the Witch King, every woman who shows the gift for sorcery must give herself up to be trained in Ghrond, where the Convent of Sorceresses teaches the Lore of Dark Magic. She may take no husband and bear no children, and lives only to serve the Witch King as one of his brides. Your gift has been noticed.
I will give up all I have and go.
No! I can still hide it...
You could not hide your gift from the eyes of Naggaroth forever. The Witch King's servants have uncovered your secret and are dragging you to Ghrond in disgrace, as was always your duty.
It was good while it lasted.
Sorceress
Your daughter [From.GetFirstName] has the gift for sorcery and has been sent to Ghrond to study with the Convent. It is a great honour for your house: she will become a bride of the Witch King.
A great honour indeed.
Another daughter of a noble house, [From.GetFirstName], has been found to have the gift and sent to Ghrond to be taught by the Convent.
Good.
The trials of Ghrond are harsh and unforgiving. Only the most gifted and cunning of the summoned master the dark powers and claim their place as Sorceresses. The rest are broken.
I must keep learning.
You have spent ten years in the dark tower, and your work has paid off. You have taken your rightful place as a bride of the Witch King, a Sorceress of the Convent.

For all your efforts, you have not passed the trials, and the hags who rule Ghrond have not found you worthy to stand among them. Bound against your will, your mind is scoured away, and you are sent to the Witch King's court as a mindless servant to satisfy his lusts.
So I have.
Gooohhh...?
Your daughter [From.GetFirstName] has proven worthy of the title of Sorceress. She has taken her place in the Convent, bringing more honour to your great house.
Good for her. And for me.
Your daughter [From.GetFirstName] has disgraced herself. She failed the final trials of the Convent and has been reduced to a mindless slave in the Witch King's harem.
Disgusting child.
